rows.definition: The model callback signature and same-named Session constructor for normalizing one full-profile V4.1 collapsed hidden row. The constructor binds the existing session-owned RMSNorm operation to the layer attn_norm.weight and HiddenSize, or returns nil when that operation is unavailable.
rows.distinction: This is the callable operation and its session-bound construction. v41AttentionInputNormWithDevice owns the BF16 input/output boundary; attentionNorm stores the resulting callback in forward state.

rows.definition: The Model adapter used at V4.1 attention-input normalization sites. A selected callback receives an owned BF16-rounded hidden row and its result is checked, copied and BF16-rounded for publication. A nil callback preserves the existing host normalization; a selected callback error is returned without host retry.
rows.distinction: This is the per-invocation BF16 and error boundary around normalization. v41AttentionInputNormFunc defines and binds the operation, while attentionNorm retains that operation across forward execution.

rows.definition: The v41ForwardState and v41ProjScratch accessor returning the session-bound attention-input RMSNorm callable from attentionNormBinding. Scratch propagation preserves binding identity; replacing either scalar edge discards canonical panel authority.
rows.distinction: This accessor exposes the normalization callable; attentionBF16Func exposes publication. v41AttentionInputNormFunc constructs the session callable, and v41AttentionInputNormWithDevice applies each scalar row boundary. The similarly named attentionNorms method returns weights and biases.

rows.definition: The shared V4.1 forward-state and scratch binding holding the attention-input RMSNorm and BF16 publication callables plus optional canonical session/model/backend provenance. Its coldPanel path admits only matching live resident ownership and validated input geometry.
rows.distinction: The binding carries joint identity and panel authority. attentionNormFunc and attentionBF16Func expose individual scalar edges; replacing either edge creates a binding without native authority and preserves scalar fallback.

rows.definition: The binding value type pairing attention-input RMSNorm and BF16 publication callables with an optional canonical native provenance record. Copying the pointer preserves identity; replacing either edge creates a binding without native authority.
rows.distinction: The type defines the value stored in attentionNormBinding; v41BoundAttentionNorm holds only its optional provenance, and v41BindAttentionNorm constructs a session binding.

rows.definition: The canonical provenance record retaining the Session, Model and comparable backend identity captured for a V4.1 attention normalization binding. Cold panel selection rechecks these identities and the live binding and resident owner.
rows.distinction: This record supplies ownership evidence, not the scalar callable pair stored in v41AttentionNormBinding or the constructor that admits it.

rows.definition: The Session constructor selecting normalization and publication closures and attaching native panel authority only when both are present and their captured model and comparable backend identities agree.
rows.distinction: This constructor grants conditional canonical provenance; setAttentionNorm and setAttentionBF16 replace scalar edges and discard that authority.

rows.definition: The Session publication constructor returning the ordinary checked BF16 closure together with the exact model and backend captured after capability admission callbacks have run.
rows.distinction: Unlike v41AttentionBF16Func, which exposes only the callable, this helper returns provenance used by v41BindAttentionNorm to validate joint ownership.

rows.definition: The forward-state setter replacing the normalization callable while preserving the current publication callable in a new binding with no native panel authority.
rows.distinction: This replaces only the normalization edge; setAttentionBF16 replaces publication. Neither setter grants the canonical provenance established by v41BindAttentionNorm.

rows.definition: The forward-state setter replacing the BF16 publication callable while preserving the current normalization callable in a new binding with no native panel authority.
rows.distinction: This replaces only the publication edge; setAttentionNorm replaces normalization. Neither setter grants the canonical provenance established by v41BindAttentionNorm.
